spans.s:
kuśá, m. grass; esp. the sacred grass, Poa
cynosuroides, with long stalks and numerous
pointed leaves.
kuśa-piñjūla, n. tuft or bunch of Kuśa.

kúśala,
 —1. a. in good condition; equal
to or fit for a task; able; clever, 46^18;
 —2. as n. welfare, well-being; kuśalaṃ
te, hail to thee.

kuśa-hasta, a. having Kuśa in the
hand. [1303.]
